topics.title: Introduction to Marketing, Marketing Concepts, Mix, Environment, Products, and Markets

subtopics.content: Basic marketing terms, history of marketing in Nigeria, marketing functions, marketing concepts (production, product, selling, societal), marketing mix (4 Ps), political/economic/social environmental factors, product classifications, product design, consumer vs organizational markets
subtopics.objective: Define marketing terms (needs, wants, demands, exchange, market) and trace Nigerian marketing history[cite: 485, 486]; evaluate marketing management philosophies[cite: 486]; analyze 4 Ps and environmental factors influencing marketing[cite: 486]; classify consumer, industrial, service, and mineral products[cite: 486]; categorize consumer, industrial, reseller, and government markets[cite: 486].

topics.title: Consumer Behaviour, Planning & Research, Pricing, Advertising, Sales Promotion, Merchandising, and Distribution

subtopics.content: Consumer/organizational decision-making process, marketing research feedback, pricing strategies (cost-plus, haggling, competition), pricing determinants, advertising media, sales promotion forms, merchandising elements (branding, packaging, labeling), distribution channels, and channel member functions
subtopics.objective: Analyze consumer and organizational buyer decision processes[cite: 486, 487]; execute marketing planning and research[cite: 487]; apply pricing strategies and evaluate price determinants[cite: 487]; evaluate advertising media and produce sample adverts[cite: 487]; analyze sales promotion methods (coupons, price-off, sampling)[cite: 487]; execute merchandising elements (branding, packaging, labeling)[cite: 487, 488]; select distribution channels and evaluate intermediaries' functions[cite: 488].

topics.title: Transportation, Warehousing, Market Unions, International Marketing, ICT, and Entrepreneurship

subtopics.content: Transportation modes/documents, warehousing functions/activities, roles of market unions and facilitators, international marketing entry/regulations, E-Marketing ethics, entrepreneurship funds, market outlet location, and sales/bargaining skills
subtopics.objective: Select transportation modes and process transport documents[cite: 488]; manage warehouse activities[cite: 488]; evaluate roles of market unions and facilitators[cite: 488]; explore international marketing methods and regulations[cite: 488]; apply E-Marketing tools and ethical practices[cite: 488]; manage market outlets, source funds, select locations, and master selling/bargaining skills[cite: 488].
